baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ places a negated ease predicate upon the named group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The preposition presents the event as a borne load; the denial/covering branch identifies the bearers, while غير negates the ready opening carried by يسير.

activation_trace.role: Covering or rejecting truth supplies the defining action of the group on whom the load falls.
Otherness and negation explicitly deny the following quality rather than merely lowering its degree.
Ease as a ready opening supplies the route or release that the predicate withholds.

changed_reading.before: The day will be difficult for unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: The event lies as a non-yielding burden upon people whose stance covers or rejects truth; no ready opening presents itself to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ can negate the smallness branch of يسير as well as ordinary ease.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negation applied to يسير as little or slight makes the burden not marginal, not brief, and not reducible to a minor inconvenience.

activation_trace.role: The negating branch reverses any attempt to minimize the predicate.
The small-amount branch contributes magnitude and duration beneath the ordinary sense of ease.

changed_reading.before: It will not be easy for them.
changed_reading.after: What bears upon them is neither easy nor slight: it cannot be dismissed as a small load or a short interval.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Within the focus roots, كفر can cover a favor and يسر can denote prosperity or means.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can carry an economic-moral undertone: covering received favor is answered by the negation of usable abundance or means.

activation_trace.role: Covering over a favor supplies ingratitude as a specific mode of the named group's concealment.
Negation removes the condition of means supplied by the following root.
Prosperity and ample means turn ease into a resource condition that can be withdrawn.

changed_reading.after: Those who cover favor meet a condition in which their former abundance supplies no usable means or facility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first addresses someone under a physical covering, then orders him to rise and warn. Against that movement from cover to public disclosure, الكافرين reads less like a bare label and more like remaining committed to concealment when disclosure is demanded.

activation_trace.role: The outer covering supplies a neutral, literal state of being wrapped at the surah's opening.
Resolute rising converts the covered state into deliberate public action.
Warning that awakens caution makes the rising an act of disclosure.

structural_cues: 74:1-2 moves immediately from a nominal address to two imperatives before the focus appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cloak, rising, and warning; I infer a contrast between removable physical cover and culpable truth-covering. Alternatively, the cloak may be only the addressee's circumstance and not a semantic foil for الكافرين.

changed_reading.before: The kafirin are a fixed doctrinal class.
changed_reading.after: They are also readable as those who remain under self-maintained concealment after the surah has modeled rising from cover to warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: A forceful striking of the trumpet initiates a day directly called arduous; the focus then restates that hardness as negated ease borne specifically upon the coverers. The second clause therefore adds distribution, not merely a synonym for the first.

activation_trace.role: A strike that leaves an effect supplies the abrupt initiating impact of the event.
Explicit difficulty and severity establish the day's general quality before the focus assigns its pressure.

structural_cues: 74:9 predicates عَسِيرٌ of the day, while 74:10 follows with عَلَى plus the named group and negated ease.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an impactful strike and an arduous day; I infer that 74:10 particularizes who bears that hardness most directly. Alternatively, the focus may be pure emphatic restatement without a distributive contrast.

changed_reading.before: A hard day occurs, and the focus repeats that it is hard.
changed_reading.after: The struck event is generally arduous, but its unrelieved pressure is then laid specifically upon those who cover truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named man receives abundant means and comprehensive preparation, still seeks increase, resists the signs, and is then burdened with an arduous ascent. This sequence activates the focus's prosperity branch of يسر and favor-covering branch of كفر as a reversal from prepared facility to obstructed climb.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated wealth supplies the material means whose eventual uselessness sharpens negated prosperity.
Preparing and leveling an affair supplies a prior condition of engineered facility.
Seeking increase turns received facility into an open-ended claim for more.
Deviation and resistance to truth identify the pivot from favor to opposition.
An imposed task that weighs heavily reverses the earlier leveling into burden.
The arduous ascent gives the withheld ease a directional image of uphill obstruction.

structural_cues: 74:12-17 progresses from wealth and thorough preparation through desire for increase and resistance to a heavily imposed ascent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior means, leveling, acquisitive desire, resistance, and uphill burden; I infer a moral reversal that explains غير يسير. Alternatively, the ascent may simply specify punishment without recoding the earlier gifts as withdrawn ease.

changed_reading.before: The difficult day is unrelated to the person's earlier prosperity.
changed_reading.after: His prepared and affluent path is inverted: covering favor while demanding increase turns facility into a burdensome uphill course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The man deliberates, calculates a formulation, turns away, and voices a recategorization of the warning as transmitted deception. The focus's كفر is thereby activated as a produced act of concealment: cognition is used to manufacture a cover for what has been encountered.

activation_trace.role: Inner back-and-forth supplies deliberate mental work rather than passive incomprehension.
Managing an affair through estimation and inspection supplies the construction of a chosen account.
Turning one's back converts deliberation into enacted refusal.
Attributing what is not so supplies the verbal cover placed over the warning.
Diversion and deception supply the category used to neutralize the warning's claim.
A report passed down supplies the dismissive explanation that the speech is merely inherited.

structural_cues: Repeated ثُمَّ in 74:20-23 slows the progression from calculation to looking, facial reaction, turning away, and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged cognitive-behavioral sequence ending in a dismissive claim; I infer that the reasoning is recruited to conceal rather than discover. Alternatively, it could portray sincerely mistaken evaluation rather than conscious manufacture.

changed_reading.before: Kafirin names people who simply lack belief.
changed_reading.after: The label can name a process: sustained thought is bent into a verbal screen that recasts disclosure as inherited manipulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same counted sign functions as an assay: it stabilizes knowledge and removes doubt for some, while diseased hearts and coverers turn it into a skeptical question. Thus غير يسير can describe an epistemic non-yielding relation to warning, not only later physical severity.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal or a person supplies a test that exposes differential composition under one stimulus.
The repeated truth-covering root explicitly places the focus group inside the split-response mechanism.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the yielding response available to the comparison group.
Agitated doubt supplies the epistemic friction that the sign does not resolve for the resistant group.
Departure from soundness locates the divergent response in the receiver, not in a different sign.

structural_cues: Within 74:31 one datum is followed by parallel but opposed responses: certainty and no doubt versus skeptical questioning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an assay and opposite responses to one sign; I infer that the test reveals and further fixes prior orientation. Alternatively, the trial may only classify reactions and leave 74:10's non-ease wholly punitive.

changed_reading.before: Non-ease is only an external punishment imposed later.
changed_reading.after: Non-ease is already visible in how a warning fails to open into certainty for the coverers and instead becomes material for destabilizing doubt.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night's darkness withdraws, dawn removes a cover, and the hearer may advance or delay. This cosmic unveiling gives the focus's covering root a temporal mechanism: difficulty is the friction of maintaining concealment while the surrounding order moves toward disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Night and its darkness supply the large-scale covering condition.
The passing end of a thing makes darkness a cover already moving away.
Removing a cover supplies the decisive transition from concealment to visibility.
Forward advance supplies the responsive motion aligned with unveiling.
Deferral to a later point supplies the contrary motion of holding back.

structural_cues: 74:32-37 orders cosmic signs from receding night to unveiling dawn, then converts the warning into an advance-or-delay choice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receding darkness, uncovered dawn, and forward or delayed motion; I infer these as an image-level explanation of كفر and its difficulty. Alternatively, the oaths may frame the warning's magnitude without describing the coverers' inner motion.

changed_reading.before: The coverers occupy a static category awaiting a hard day.
changed_reading.after: They resist a moving disclosure: as concealment recedes and warning calls for advance, holding back becomes increasingly non-yielding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every self is held as a pledge by what it acquired; the denied day is one of accounting and recompense, and no joined advocate provides benefit. This activates عَلَى in the focus as an encumbrance attached to conduct rather than an arbitrary load on a label.

activation_trace.role: The self as the very entity supplies the individually accountable bearer.
Acquisition supplies the conduct that generates the pledge's claim.
A document or object held against a right supplies the legal-economic image of encumbrance.
Accounting and recompense identify the forum in which acquired conduct comes due.
The explicit absence of benefit closes an easy route to release.
Joining an advocate to another supplies the third-party relief that fails to discharge the burden.

structural_cues: 74:38 begins universally with every self, 74:39 marks an exception, and 74:43-48 gives conduct, denied accounting, and failed intercession as the explanatory chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self, acquisition, pledge, accounting, and failed joined advocacy; I infer that عَلَى evokes a conduct-backed encumbrance. Alternatively, رهينة may express dependence broadly rather than a technically dischargeable lien.

changed_reading.before: Hardship is simply placed on an externally named group.
changed_reading.after: The pressure upon them is an earned encumbrance: the self is held against its acquisitions, with no beneficial third party able to make release easy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close reopens remembrance, nests creaturely willing under divine willing, and ends with fitness for protection and forgiveness. This weakens any reading of غير يسير as an absolute metaphysical closure: severe non-ease remains, but the text's final horizon still includes recalled warning and sin-covering protection.

activation_trace.role: A reminder that causes recollection supplies an avenue back from active concealment.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the condition governing actual remembrance.
Fitness and entitlement bind protection and forgiveness into the closing parallel.
Averting harm through protection supplies the positive counterpart to unrelieved burden.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer from its effect supplies a reparative form of covering.

structural_cues: 74:54-56 repeats reminder and remembrance, places human willing beneath divine willing, and closes with the balanced phrases أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ and أَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, conditioned willing, protection, and forgiveness; I infer that these qualify an absolute-closure reading of the focus. Alternatively, the closing attributes may state a general truth without promising transition for those named in 74:10.

changed_reading.before: The focus fixes the coverers in a condition from which no opening is conceivable.
changed_reading.after: The focus states severe, unrelieved difficulty without making concealment the final ontology; remembrance and protective forgiveness remain in the surah's closing frame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface adjective يسير ordinarily activates ease, not the maysir branch of lots and apportioned shares. It remains anchored in the focus's ي س ر inventory and is activated by the explicit count functioning as a human assay in 74:31. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary wordplay-like resonance, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word يَسِيرٍ carries a branch involving gambling lots and apportioned shares.

activation_trace.role: Gambling lots and divided shares supply the form-distant possibility of an outcome one hopes to manage or win.
Explicit enumeration supplies the counted object that activates the lots-and-allotment resonance.
Assay turns the count into a revealing test rather than a number the resistant can game.

changed_reading.before: The day is simply not easy.
changed_reading.after: At a contained secondary level, it is no favorable draw or manageable allotment for the coverers; the counted sign tests them instead of yielding an outcome they can game.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a form-distant expiation branch inside ك ف ر with the distinct root غ ف ر and with cosmic uncovering. It remains valid as an image-level contrast anchored in the focus root and supplied context branches: truth is culpably covered, dawn removes cover, and sin may be reparatively covered. Downstream prose must mark this as semantic counterpoint, not etymological identity or a direct gloss of الكافرين.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's ك ف ر inventory contains both truth-covering and an expiatory covering that effaces fault.

activation_trace.role: Covering truth supplies the culpable direction of concealment named by the focus.
Expiatory covering that effaces fault supplies a reparative possibility within the same root inventory.
Removing a cover at dawn supplies the surah's counter-motion of disclosure.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer supplies the closing reparative cover.

changed_reading.before: Covering is a uniformly negative image equivalent to unbelief.
changed_reading.after: The focus condemns a direction of covering, truth concealed against disclosure, while the surah also imagines cover removed and fault mercifully covered.

strongest_changes: The immediate trumpet and arduous-day sequence turns generic difficulty into a struck event whose pressure is assigned specifically to the coverers.
The wealthy man's leveled life, demand for increase, resistance, and uphill burden make غير يسير a reversal of former means and prepared facility.
The deliberation sequence and the sign-as-assay sequence recast كفر from a static label into manufactured concealment and a non-yielding response to evidence.
The pledge, acquisition, accounting, and failed intercession sequence makes عَلَى readable as a conduct-backed encumbrance.
The closing reminder and forgiveness language blocks an absolute-closure reading while preserving the focus's severity.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changed the focus through material relations rather than topic alone: cover becomes disclosure, prepared smoothness becomes ascent, one sign sorts receivers, and a burden becomes a pledge. The focus root inventories also preserve secondary senses of slightness, means, lots, and reparative covering that ordinary paraphrase would flatten.
remaining_uncertainties: The not-slight and withdrawn-means readings are plausible branch resonances beneath ordinary syntax, but neither should displace the primary sense of not easy.
The cosmic-uncovering and pledge mechanisms may be contextual elaborations rather than lexical revisions of 74:10.
The closing forgiveness frame limits claims of absolute closure, but the packet does not specify when or whether a person named among the coverers changes stance.
The counted-lots outlier is deliberately form-distant and should remain marked as resonance rather than translation.
